canonical_project: Gujarat State Data Centre - Vadodara mini/colocation node
notes: Government state-data-centre node. Academic paper (IJCSEITR, Dec 2019) states GSDC provides mini/colocation data centre at Vadodara. No commercial/hyperscale project found for Vadodara district; Gujarat DC activity (Yotta G1, CtrlS Gandhinagar 1, Reliance Jamnagar, Dholera AI DC) sits in other districts. Capacity not disclosed.
